FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS, SECTOR 25,
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH 160014
Advertisement for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Applications are invited along with the complete bio-data and attested copies of certificates showing
qualifications and experience for one post of JRF in the research project entitled “Development of
gold nanoparticles based lateral flow immunoassay for rapid and early detection of novel
biomarker miR204 in type 2 diabetes (T1D)” by ICMR, Government of India (17X(3)/Ad-
hox/69/2022-ITR) granted to Drs. Ravi Pratap Barnwal and Gurpal Singh. Intial appointment is for
one year, extended up to 3 years based on the performance. Applications should reach the undersigned
by 28/02/2023 either by post or email at barnwal@pu.ac.in
Eligibility: M.Sc. in Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Chemistry/allied subjects
with minimum 55% marks. “Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/ other national entrance test
conducted by Government of India will be preferred.”
Desirable: Experience with nucleic acids, nanotechnology and lateral flow assay
Emoluments: Rs. 31,000/-p.m.+ 18% HRA for three years as per ICMR or Panjab University
guidelines.
Yours sincerely
SD
Ravi Pratap Barnwal, Ph.D.
Department of Biophysics, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with project.
Candidates should mention their email address and phone number in the bio data.
